key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0000
name: store_self_address_then_trap
description: Saves the routine's own code address in a global cell, raises trap zero, and returns zero. It acts as the program entry that hands control to the trap handler.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:000E
name: run_beam_control_setup_sequence
description: Writes the display beam control register, then calls a series of helper routines interleaved with writes of zero and 32 to a global cell. It sequences initial hardware setup by calling those helpers.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0052
name: copy_table_to_low_memory
description: Copies ten long words from a table in the routine's own code into low memory starting at address zero. It then stores two words and one long relative to the custom chip base, taken from globals.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0080
name: save_dma_state_restore_table
description: Saves two custom control words with their set bit forced on, clears and then re-enables DMA through the DMA control register, and stores a long from a global. It then copies ten long words from low memory back into the code table and zeroes low memory.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:00EE
name: fill_two_pointer_table_entries
description: Writes the low and high words of an address into two eight-byte table entries, with the address advancing by 28 bytes between entries.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:011E
name: fill_two_pointer_table_entries
description: Writes the low and high words of an address into two eight-byte table entries, with the address advancing by 28 bytes between entries.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0144
name: swap_and_fill_pointer_entries
description: Swaps two long-word cells, then writes the low and high words of an address that advances by 40 bytes into two eight-byte table entries.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0176
name: wait_blitter_then_program_registers
description: Busy-waits until the blitter busy flag clears, then writes a long-word value to the blitter register block, clears a modulo word, and writes a control word.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:019A
name: build_copper_list_entries
description: Writes 144 six-long-word groups: each holds a counter-based word, moves aimed at the bitplane pointer registers, and a colour register move, with one word copied from the source into each group.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:01F6
name: walk_table_until_sentinel
description: Walks a list of word-sized records until the next record holds the end marker, calling a helper for each record. It returns the value of the final record.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0216
name: step_colours_toward_target
description: Stores the start colour in a word buffer, then repeatedly moves each of the three four-bit colour channels one unit toward the target colour, storing each step until they match.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:027C
name: read_keyboard_serial_byte
description: Switches the keyboard serial line direction through the CIA-A control register, waits a short delay, then reads and inverts the serial data register, returning it shifted right by one bit. It keeps a small retry counter of up to five.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:02F4
name: update_cursor_from_key_code
description: Calls a helper first, then, when a key code and an enable flag are set, steps one of two cursor counters modulo eight for four key codes or sets fixed values for two others.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:038A
name: poll_status_and_service
description: Repeatedly waits for a ready flag on a status byte, then calls a helper eight times, and continues while a bit in a global flag stays set. The status reads touch the fire button and disk status port.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:03C4
name: clear_table_after_vertical_wait
description: Waits until the vertical beam position reaches a fixed line, then zeroes four words in each of 144 twenty-four-byte records.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:03FA
name: fill_scaled_row_pointers
description: Reads a table value from an index that advances by a stride, then in a 144-pass loop stores low and high words of an address stepping by 40 bytes into pairs of slots in a scaled pointer table.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:046C
name: blit_scrolling_text_glyphs
description: Advances a scroll position, computes twelve scaled offsets from a value, waits for the blitter, then for each row and column draws characters from a text pointer, skipping spaces, using blitter register writes.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:062A
name: blit_tile_grid_pass
description: Clears four blitter-related cells, then for each entry of a sixteen-by-sixteen word table waits for the blitter, programs its shift and control values from the entry, and starts a blit.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0668
name: blit_tile_grid_from_arguments
description: Walks a sixteen-by-sixteen word table, waiting for the blitter before each step, and programs blitter shift and control values from each entry using the address arguments passed in.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:06BC
name: build_scaled_multiplication_tables
description: Fills a sixteen-by-sixteen word table with row and column products scaled and divided by fifteen, then fills a second table with the difference from the index and a one-bit mask shifted by the first value.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0704
name: reorder_bits_of_words
description: For each of 960 words, it rebuilds the word by taking one bit at a time from the source, rotating a single-bit mask and shifting each bit to a new position, so the bit order is rearranged.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0740
name: chain_three_calls_return_pair
description: Calls three helper routines in turn, then returns the contents of two data registers as one combined eight-byte result.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0768
name: call_library_vector_fallback
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer read from a library vector table, stores its result, and if that result is zero calls a second vector.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:076A
name: call_routine_via_vector
description: Calls one routine through a vector at a negative offset from the library base and returns.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:076C
name: fill_buffer_from_helper_calls
description: Makes three vector calls to set up, then loops once per count, storing each value a helper returns into a buffer and making one more vector call per pass.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:076E
name: parse_number_with_mathffp
description: Uses library vector calls to read and compare values, stores four and three values into two buffers, and returns a signed number. The code refers to the mathffp library by name.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:07E0
name: read_signed_number_via_vectors
description: Repeats the vector call sequence of its neighbour to read a value, stores four and three values into two buffers, and returns a signed number.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0900
name: wrap_call_pass_registers
description: Calls one routine and passes the register results back to the caller unchanged, acting as a thin wrapper.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0904
name: wrap_call_pass_registers
description: Calls one routine and passes the register results back to the caller unchanged, acting as a thin wrapper.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0912
name: silence_four_audio_channels
description: Zeroes the period registers of all four audio channels and clears a sound state cell, then disables the four audio DMA channels through the DMA control register.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0942
name: init_music_channel_records
description: Sets a playback flag and builds a table of cumulative period values, then initialises four music channel records of 74 bytes each from a three-byte-per-entry source table and writes pointers into sample buffers. It refers to the SMOD module tag by name.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0AEA
name: advance_audio_playback_tick
description: When playback is enabled, counts down a tick timer. On zero it reloads the timer and updates four channels through helpers, then writes each channel's pointer, length and period to the audio registers and enables DMA.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0C6C
name: step_channel_music_stream
description: Advances one channel's music stream: reads note bytes and per-note parameters, reloads the sample pointer, length and volume from a table, and sets the channel's DMA enable bit.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:0D8A
name: interpret_music_channel_commands
description: Runs a channel's music script by processing command bytes for end of stream, jumps, note and sample selection, repeats and parameter changes. It then computes a period from the current note and envelope, clamped to fixed bounds, and returns it.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:1996
name: shift_multiword_state_bits
description: Waits on a countdown, then shifts a set of sixteen-bit state words one bit left, carrying each top bit into the next word, and copies selected words into output cells. It reloads the countdown through a helper.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:DEFJAM:0:1A5A
name: parse_text_script_commands
description: Reads a command string: a colour command writes a colour register, two commands set cells from digits, and lowercase letters set a counter. Other characters look up table values to write four bitplane bytes.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:0000
name: run_startup_sequence
description: Program entry: calls a helper, stores the returned library base, optionally calls a vector when a flag bit is set, then calls another vector and runs a second routine when its result is nonzero.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:0006
name: call_helper_with_fixed_pairs
description: Calls a helper with fixed pairs of small values: zero and ten, twenty and thirty, forty and fifty, then zero with its parameter, followed by two calls with no arguments.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:008C
name: run_title_screen_boot
description: Waits on a timer, calls a series of setup routines, loads the title data file by name, clears a state flag and several counters, then loops forever calling helper routines.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:0204
name: run_setup_then_spin
description: Makes three calls, one passing the value ninety-six, then enters an endless loop that never returns.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:0234
name: show_disc_ready_prompt
description: Calls a helper with a value and a pointer to the text "Check disc is ready", then makes three more helper calls. It presents the disc readiness prompt.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:027C
name: init_records_from_helper_count
description: Reads a count from a helper, then fills that many records of 62 bytes each with fixed field values and a helper result, and finally sets two fields of a shared record.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:032A
name: rebuild_record_table_with_frames
description: Walks a table of 62-byte records, copies the one matching a given pointer into the free slot with its position advanced, picks animation frame offsets from an eight-entry table for flagged records, and appends two fixed records.

key: Football Manager - World Cup Edition/Football Manager - World Cup Edition.adf:wcfm:0:06BA
name: dispatch_through_handler_table
description: Calls one routine, then calls a handler from a table of pointers, selected by the low four bits of its second argument.
